claims.assertion: Yazhi says collective human fear and suffering create and sustain negative tulpa-egregore entities, which she portrays as feeding on that attention and causing further harm; she says refusing fear and obedience weakens them.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: This is her metaphysical explanation of human suffering and control.

review_flags: The source makes unverified metaphysical claims and includes harmful conspiratorial assertions about real people and institutions.
coverage_gaps: The source also discusses positive egregores and additional claims about humanlike entities and collective consciousness.
